values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: Seven rustic sites 'for tents and small trailers' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted), plus one walk-in site for backpackers. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/hopkinscreek ('provides seven rustic sites for tents and small trailers', 'There is one walk-in site for backpackers', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (7 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground along the edge of Hopkins Creek (trout) in dense evergreen forest, 5.5 mi N of Arlene via M-42 and Lucas Road, Missaukee County; managed by Mitchell State Park. A stop on the 420-mile Shore-to-Shore hiking and riding trail. It shares an access road with the separate Hopkins Creek Equestrian State Forest Campground and Trail Camp, but horses and ORVs are prohibited in this campground. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 7 tent/small-trailer sites + 1 walk-in, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (inherited max now confirmed). Season (open all year) already manual and matches. Phone 231-775-7911 matches (Mitchell SP). Note trimmed of field restatements.
